# Tests That Are Not User-Level Recipes

This page is the explicit rejection list requested in the Friday call: tests here should not become standalone device recipes unless the source behavior changes or a human writes a higher-level workflow around them.

A rejected standalone recipe can still be valuable as an expected error, a test vector, or an implementation conformance case.

## Counts By Reason

| Outcome | Count |
|---|---:|
| Guardrail, not standalone | 45 |
| Not a recipe - benchmark/stress | 20 |
| Not a recipe - disabled | 10 |
| Not a recipe - internal support | 31 |
| Not a recipe - test harness | 3 |
| Spec/test vector | 101 |
